name: workspace
//: Repo-level checks over the whole graph: the project-boundary check (tools/check-project-boundaries.mjs against tools/project-boundaries.json) with its tests, and the supply-chain check. It depends on every other project so any change re-runs the cheap boundary check; that check reads every project.json and Cargo.toml, which its inputs name, so it replays from cache when none changed. The coverage gate is the nested coverage project.

supply-chain.//: Workspace-wide by nature and network-bound (cargo deny's advisory DB), so outside the gate tiers: `just deps-check` and CI's deny job run it.
